messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — noticed playbook automation firing on accounts with no activity 90+ days. Possible playbook drift. Need a snooze policy or drift detector. :eyes:

sam_playbooks: ugh, thanks for flagging. is this the renewal-check playbook? saw a spike in runs yesterday.

playbook-bot: Automation "renewal-check" triggered for account ACCT-7129 (last_activity: 2024-05-10) — run_id: 7781

maria_cs: yes renewal-check. A bunch are old trials that never onboarded. They shouldn't be in high-touch flows.

anya_data: can you share a sample query of affected accounts? i can run an overnight job to label 'stale' vs 'active' (thresholds: 60/90/180 days).

sam_playbooks: idea: add drift detector that compares segment membership vs last 60d telemetry. If no events -> auto-snooze playbook for 180d, and mark as 'low-touch'.

josh_eng: FYI adding auto-snooze will touch the playbook engine config — recommend feature flag rollout and safe off-ramp. I can help with a canary.

maria_cs: proposed next steps:
- anya: produce sample list + counts by last_activity bucket
- sam: draft playbook rule + snooze TTL
- josh: implement flag + canary
- i'll prepare comms to CSMs

anya_data: SQL for sampling:
```
SELECT account_id, last_activity_at, onboarding_state
FROM accounts
WHERE last_activity_at < now() - interval '60 days'
AND trial_start IS NOT NULL;
```

sam_playbooks: i'll sketch rule config:
```
when: renewal-check && account.last_activity_days > 90
action: set_playbook_snoozed(true)
metadata: { snooze_ttl_days: 180, reason: "stale_no_telemetry" }
```

maria_cs: timeline? can we aim for pilot next week? :thumbsup:

josh_eng: can do a canary on 5% of accounts next Thurs. I'll add telemetry events for "snooze_applied" so ops can verify.

playbook-bot: Created issue PB-4023: "playbook drift: snooze policy" and assigned to @sam_playbooks

sam_playbooks: thanks — i'll create the PR and link here. tagging @maria_cs for acceptance criteria.

maria_cs: acceptance criteria: no more than 2 false snoozes in pilot, clear rollback path, and docs for CSMs on how to unsnooze.

anya_data: i'll also add a daily diff job that alerts if >10% of playbook runs are from accounts with last_activity >180d.

maria_cs: perfect. i'll schedule a quick sync Thurs 10am. Thanks all!
